task.pr_title: feat(platform): extend Country type standardization to equity screeners

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
If the value fails to parse as a Country, it likely is not a valid string. Instead of letting it through to the API call, we should validate the value against the list of accepted countries.

```suggestion
                country_code = v.strip().lower()
```

Without the raised ValueError, the user gets returned an EmptyDataError instead, which is missing the helpful message with the valid options.

evidence.attached_diff_hunk:
@@ -98,13 +100,34 @@ class YFinanceEquityScreenerQueryParams(EquityScreenerQueryParams):
         description="Limit the number of results returned. Default is, 200. Set to, 0, for all results.",
     )
 
+    @field_validator("country", mode="before")
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_country(cls, v):
+        """Validate and normalize country input."""
+        if v is None or v == "all":
+            return v
+        # Convert Country type or string to lowercase alpha-2 for YFinance
+        if isinstance(v, Country):
+            country_code = v.alpha_2.lower()
+        else:
+            try:
+                country_code = Country(v).alpha_2.lower()
+            except ValueError:
+                return v  # Let it fail at API level if invalid
